verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for https://developers.notion.com/openapi.json with an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is downloadable for the documented REST API. A machine-readable llms.txt index of the docs is also published. missing for 10: first-party documentation that points users to or describes the spec, and evidence of its completeness and versioning against the full REST surface.
